headline: Donald Trump Hosts Meme Coin Event Following $TRUMP Token Price Decline
summary: Donald Trump hosted a dinner event for holders of the $TRUMP meme coin despite lighter demand and recent declines in the cryptocurrency token's market valuation.
why: Politically affiliated meme tokens reflect speculative cryptocurrency trading patterns and brand monetisation within digital asset markets.
